rv.q: For all her fantastic claims, she fascinates him. Brittle and elegant, she is like one of the ceramic swans in his secret collection. Claiming to be in love with a man named Tchaikovsky, she is a human addition to his private Swan Lake.

There's also a lot of sensitivity in how the story is handled and there are some real moments of vulnerability. With a solid script and wonderful performances, this makes for an extremely entertaining play.
